description: A tool-only document naming `adapter: scripted` with no config.json: `replies_file` falls back to the conventional `scripted-replies.yaml`, which doesn't exist, so preflight's own `check()` call fails hard (no named effects reference the adapter at all, so there is no soft/skippable usage to downgrade it) before any effect dispatches. The OS's own strerror text is third-party, masked by the conformance harness's own message-shape catalogue (tests/conformance/README.md); the errno and the path stay exact.
